scope: General self-contained archimedean Fock and rational lattice proofs, 199 mathematical exact guards plus52 frozen-source pins; normal and -OO outputs byte-identical. Full integral order elements, not automatically natively available gates. Metric, complex polarization, Gaussian measure and half-form are explicit existing extra data; no derivation from the bare rational source. Fock trace is not a probability or CP evaluation. Exact composition only within the common-fixed-line semigroup; no full adjoint-preserving representation. The lattice projection along F and orthogonal analytic Q are distinct. No full affine intertwiner, derived character-to-half-form normalization, all-place signed trace or RH.
